question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "**both**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Both" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank, as it indicates that two things are being compared or happening at the same time.(दोनों)**
 
• **In case of the given passage, the word both will emphasis on 'philosophy' as well as 'educational offshoot.**
 
• It is grammatically correct to use "both" in this context. 
 
• Using "concurrently" or "similarly" would not be appropriate, as they do not convey the same meaning as "both".
 
• "Among" could be used, but it does not convey the same emphasis on two things happening together.

Hence,** the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Concurrently" means happening at the same time, but does not indicate specifically that two things are happening together.(साथ-साथ)
 
• "Among" indicates that there are multiple things being compared or included, but does not specifically indicate that two things are happening together.(के बीच)
 
• "Similarly" indicates that two things are similar, but does not necessarily indicate that they are happening at the same time or being compared.(उसी प्रकार)
